# The Modern Minimalist

Category: `minimal` · Audience: Frontend and full-stack engineers · Output: static HTML/CSS/JS

A precise, spacious portfolio that puts product impact, thoughtful engineering, and shipped work first.

A broad impact hero, two-column project gallery, skills tag cloud, paired career entries, split About, and a simple direct-contact close. Quiet 8px cards and deliberate whitespace.

## Design tokens

| Token | Exact value |
| --- | --- |
| accent | `#1D4ED8` |
| background | `#FAFAFA` |
| text | `#111113` |
| muted | `#62626B` |
| surface | `#FFFFFF` |
| border | `#D8D8DF` |
| Body family | 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| Heading family | 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| Font styles | body: sans; heading: sans |
| Density | spacious |

Text, muted text, and accent contrast against the background / card surface:

| Foreground | Background | Surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | 18.07:1 | 18.86:1 |
| muted | 5.78:1 | 6.04:1 |
| accent | 6.42:1 | 6.70:1 |

The preset text combinations exceed 4.5:1. Decorative borders are not used to convey essential information. Custom colors need a new contrast check; this palette check alone is not a full WCAG conformance audit.

## Default content and order

Hero → Projects → Skills → Experience → About → Contact

All identities, organizations, metrics, and work below are fictional examples. Links use example.com. The default footer labels them as illustrative; replace them before removing that label in Theme controls.
